ios.desc:
With Hueo, you can test, emulate, and create perfect colors on your screen with industry-standard accuracy:

• Choose from the best color gels in the industry, like Rosco and Lee Filters.
• In Picker Mode, slide between RGB, HSL, HSV, and CCT color selectors, to find the perfect tone. View and copy the HEX code for easy reference.
• In CCT Mode, emulate any Kelvin color temperature with green and magenta tint adjustments. Ideal for film shoots and lighting tests.
• Use it as a prop light or eye-light on set, or at home for testing out filter gels before buying them.

Starting today, the Hueo Pro upgrade is also available, which includes:
• VFX Trackers: Professional crosshairs and indicators for Chroma Keying on green screens, or any color you want.
• Favourites: You can add your most used colors to your favourites to easily find them.
• Hide All: You can hide the entire interface in full-screen mode for an even more immersive experience.
And many more new features will be added in the coming weeks.

All colors are calibrated at D65 (6500K) for accurate results on any iOS device. 
Remember to turn off Night Shift and True Tone for the best color precision.

Whether you’re on a professional shoot, testing filter gels, or just learning creative lighting, 
Hueo is your go-to color emulation and chroma key tracking tool.
Try it yourself, and choose your favourite shades!
